chapter: Life in France and Sidney Bechet
title: Visiting Bechet in Belgium, cleaning his pistol
summary: Waters recalls going to Bechet's room at the casino in Belgium and finding him cleaning a pistol, and describes Bechet as a character and a big shot.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Sidney Bechet: the man, the horn, the legend

blocks.x: Naah, nah. And then, and the last time I saw Sidney Bechet - well, not exactly the last time that I saw him in the theater but I was playing in a place called Cannuck [?], Belgium, which Cannuck, Belgium is considered the greatest - what do you call those things - casinos, supposed to be the greatest casino in Europe, Cannuck. Supposed to be, they have all the big things that they have, the shows and they have the model shows, [ ], you know - fashion shows, see, had all big things. Well, I was playing the Cannuck, I was playing there in a little room with a Belgian band that this guy used to sing like Nat King Cole, on that order, you know. A little jazz too, but you know, it was built around him singin', you know, and he played guitar. So I was working in my [ ] room there, and the city where I was working, it's called Dixie Room, from the Dixieland, Dixie Room they called it, you know, named it after Dixieland. So I went around to see him in this place, I just heard about all this stuff - anyone, I just hung out here because big shot, you know, I could get things quickly, see. So I went right in to see Sidney sittin' in his room like this and I knocked on his door - 'Good', I said, 'Benny Waters' - he knew me, you know, see. 'Ah, come in'. When I came in he had his [ ] gun there along cleanin' it.
[ ], all clean - you know how you clean it, clean the whole unit.
It was a little wire bush that you hooked (PS laughs). You know, that was some character there. Some character, that's Sidney, was some character, you know. But he was [a] big shot in France -
Because he knew all the big people.
